title: WF03 IDN-01/SCH-07 blocker set: missing IDN integration entrypoint wiring and SCH recurring startup/payload assertion regressions

root_cause.description: IDN-01 integration tests were not compiled by the integration entrypoint, and SCH recurring/startup integration checks were blocked by recurring re-arm startup behavior plus brittle payload-string assertions tied to jsonb text formatting.

resolution.summary: Imported IDN-01 integration tests into the integration entrypoint, aligned module wiring for IDN integration imports, changed recurring re-arm base timestamp to actual fire time to prevent startup catch-up over-firing, and hardened SCH payload assertions to tolerate jsonb spacing while preserving fired_late field verification.

actions: When adding a new integration suite file, always import it in tests/integration/main_test.zig before claiming coverage.
For jsonb payload assertions in integration tests, avoid strict whitespace-sensitive substring checks.
For recurring timers on startup, base re-arm scheduling on actual fire timestamp to avoid catch-up burst firing in one sweep.
